Project Description

4093 - Publix - Tower Square - Gainesville, FL - Scrape and Rebuild

This is a Scrape and Rebuild of an Existing Publix in Gainesville, FL.

Scope includes, but not limited to, site demolition, building demolition, earthwork, erosion control, site utilities, asphalt paving, asphalt striping, curbs, walks, site furnishings, landscaping & irrigation, soil treatment, site concrete, cast-in place concrete, polished concrete, structural steel, steel erection, resilient flooring, rough carpentry, finish carpentry, millwork, countertops, waterproofing, foamed-in-place insulation, building insulation, fireproofing, EIFS, single-ply membrane roofing, metal roofing, roof accessories, join sealers and caulking, hollow metal doors and frames, wood doors, overhead doors, entrances & storefront, automatic entrances, gypsum drywall, hard tile, acoustical ceilings, paints and coatings, toilet partitions & accessories, wall & corner guards, signage, metal lockers, shelving, loading dock equipment, residential appliances, blinds, fire extinguishers, awnings & canopies, entrance mats, lifts, fire protection, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, fire alarm.

This project will take place during normal business hours.

Please provide the following cost breakout on your proposal. This breakout is required by the owner for cost allocation purposes; however, contracts will still be awarded based on overall total bid.

Publix Building - This is to include everything part of the Publix Box set of Plans
Publix Front Façade - This is to include everything part of the Façade Plans for the Front Elevation Only
Publix Side and Rear Façade - This is to include the remaining 3 sides of the building per the Façade plans
Retail Shops - This is to include everything as part of the Retail Set of Plans
Site work - This is to include everything part of the Site Work Plans set
Phase 2 – Roadway Improvements – This is to include everything part of the Phase 2 - Roadway Improvements set of Plans.

Please also provide a total for all these scopes put together. Please let us know if you have any questions.

Estimated start date of 2/5/2027 with a completion date of 2/29/2028.

If you have any questions please contact Alex Contact at 555-010-0200 or at contact@example.com.

The bid date for this project will be on Tuesday 10/20/26 at 10:00 AM EST.

NOTE: PLEASE ACCEPT OR DECLINE THIS BID INVITATION IF YOU HAVE NOT DONE SO ALREADY. THIS WAY YOU WILL NOT RECEIVE ADDITIONAL NOTIFICATIONS. Also, if you are receiving a fax and would prefer the Invitation emailed to you, please supply us with an email address. Thank you.
